result:
Round 102 is implemented and waiting for C. I haven't claimed any of C's acceptance rows. No commits, pushes or server restarts.

**What changed** (HEAD still `56231c0`; working tree is exactly 3 modified files and 1 new file; all 533 frozen files and the protected files are unchanged):
- **`ArrangementExportDialog.tsx`**
  - **Focus guard:** it now measures whichever sits lower: the focused control, or its option card (the `<label>`), when that card is inside the panel.
  - **Progress text:** it is computed once into `progressText`. The visible label gets `aria-hidden="true"`, and the bar's `aria-valuetext` uses the same value. Every diff hunk is inside B's allowed line ranges.
- **`export-dialog-footer.test.tsx`:** new tests FC1, FC2, FC3 and FA1, plus FC4, which the code-reviewer asked for and B did not list. It is one pure addition after l.491.
- **Doc 089:** only the status line (l.4) changed.
- **Doc 090:** new, in Georgian.

**Checks I ran**
- `npm run typecheck` and `npm run lint` pass. Lint reports 218 warnings across the repo and none from my two code files.
- Biome on my two code files: no diagnostics, and formatting is unchanged.
- Targeted tests: 13 files, 143/143 pass. I did not run the full suite; that's the root gate's job.
- **Fail-before** (my tests against B's baseline snapshot): FC1 and FA1 fail, the other 13 pass, as B expected.
- **Mutations:**
  - a (measure the control only): FC1 fails.
  - b (measure the card only): FT4, FC2 and FC4 fail.
  - d (no `aria-hidden`): FA1 fails.
  - c (drop the "card is inside the panel" check): no test can catch it, because no reachable page puts the card outside the panel. I did not invent one.
  - e (a second copy of the progress-text call): it behaves the same, so nothing fails, as expected.

**My own browser reproduction** (Chromium, copies of B's probes):
- **Focus:** at 1280×720 after a WAV export, the panel now scrolls 59 px instead of 43. The card's bottom moves from 8 px under the footer to 8 px above it.
- **No regressions seen:** the idle state and both 1440 cases still don't scroll, and the Tab order is unchanged.
- **Accessibility tree:** the duplicate text node is gone, the progress text appears once in the dialog, and the bar keeps its name `ექსპორტის პროგრესი`.

Two process slips:
- I edited the dialog while the "before" probe was still running against the live server. I stopped it, put back B's baseline copy of the dialog, re-ran "before", then restored my edit.
- One "after" run was cut off by a page reload, most likely caused by my test-file edit. The second run completed with nothing changing in `store/`.

**Code-reviewer:** 8.5/10, no Critical, High or Medium findings. I fixed three Lows/nits: FC4 added, FC1 checks the panel, duplicate assertion removed. One Low stays open for the Tech Lead: some screen readers (historically VoiceOver with Safari) ignore `aria-valuetext` on a native `<progress>`. On those, the phase text is now lost, most of all in the MP3 load phase, where the bar has no value. I kept B's chosen approach. Its Architecture note is in the report verbatim. It is a proposal only, and I made no refactor: if this area changes again, merge the dialog's four focus effects into one local hook.

**Not done by me, left for C:**
- whether the card's top is still below the panel's top after the scroll;
- an accessibility-tree sample during an MP3 export;
- a real screen-reader check.

The exact next C checks are listed in the report.

Files are in `/home/runner/czaba-project/tmp/studio-real-loop/`:
- a-round-102.md
- a-round-102/a-round-102-summary.json — moved there because `a-round-102-result.json` is generated by the harness and would be overwritten
